services.name: Sandhill Crane Kayak Tour
services.desc: Our winter neoprene paddle mittens (poagies), waterproof jacket, and drip skirt will keep you nice and warm out on the water. We also provide hot chocolate or apple cider after your kayak adventure ends. This trip is a fun way to meet new friends or get your old friends off of the couch to try something new. The Tennessee Sandhill Crane Festival is held on January 13-14, 2024. This is a great time to join us on a kayak tour as there will be plenty of free activities after your kayak tour for you to participate in. The festival runs from 8 am to 4 pm daily. blurb: Guests can join guided kayak tours exploring local rivers and wildlife, including the Nickajack Bat Cave, downtown Chattanooga bridges, Tennessee River Gorge fall colors, and Sandhill Crane winter tours. Mountain bike rentals are available with delivery and pickup options, offering a range of full suspension and hardtail bikes for local trail systems. Tours are beginner and family friendly, with all necessary equipment provided.
